example: She ignored my advice and successfully repaired the chair.
translation: U maslahatimni e’tiborsiz qoldirib, stulni muvaffaqiyatli tuzatdi.

example: Dad threatened to sing if we didn't get out of bed.
translation: O‘rnimizdan turmasak, dadam qo‘shiq aytishini aytib do‘q qildi.

example: There is no need to shout; your microphone is already on.
translation: Baqirish shart emas; mikrofoningiz allaqachon yoqilgan.

example: I screamed when a cold spoon touched my neck.
translation: Bo‘ynimga sovuq qoshiq tekkanda chinqirib yubordim.

example: My cousins tease me about the time I got lost in our own garden.
translation: Amakivachchalarim o‘z bog‘imizda adashganimni eslatib meni mazax qilishadi.

example: Office gossip travels faster than the lift.
translation: Ofisdagi g‘iybat liftdan tezroq tarqaladi.

example: A rumour that the boss was leaving turned out to mean he was going to lunch.
translation: Boshliq ketayotgani haqidagi mish-mish uning tushlikka chiqishini anglatgan ekan.

example: His lie about finishing the washing up was exposed by the mountain of plates.
translation: Idishlarni yuvib bo‘lgani haqidagi yolg‘onini tog‘day uyilgan likopchalar fosh qildi.

example: I misunderstood 'bring something light' and arrived with a lamp.
translation: «Yengil narsa olib kel» degan gapni noto‘g‘ri tushunib, chiroq olib keldim.

example: Reading jokes during her speech was disrespectful.
translation: Uning nutqi paytida latifalar o‘qish hurmatsizlik edi.

example: The brothers fell out over who had to wash the enormous pan.
translation: Ulkan tovani kim yuvishi masalasida aka-uka arazlashib qolishdi.

example: I apologised for the noise before revealing my new drum kit.
translation: Yangi barabanlarimni ko‘rsatishdan oldin shovqin uchun uzr so‘radim.

example: His apology was longer than the speech he had interrupted.
translation: Uning uzri o‘zi gapini bo‘lgan odamning nutqidan ham uzun edi.

example: She forgave me for shrinking her jumper, but the teddy bear kept it.
translation: U jemperini kichraytirib qo‘yganimni kechirdi, lekin jemper ayiqchada qoldi.

example: Excuse me, I think you are wearing my coat and holding your own.
translation: Kechirasiz, menimcha, mening paltomni kiyib, o‘zingiznikini ushlab turibsiz.

example: We made up after discovering that neither of us had eaten the missing cake.
translation: Yo‘qolgan tortni ikkalamiz ham yemaganimizni bilib yarashdik.

example: We compromised and watched half a film before going for a walk.
translation: O‘zaro yon berib, sayrga chiqishdan oldin filmning yarmini ko‘rdik.

example: I value your honesty, even when it concerns my terrible haircut.
translation: Hatto yomon soch turmagim haqida bo‘lsa ham, rostgo‘yligingni qadrlayman.

example: My sister backed me up when I said the dog had opened the cupboard.
translation: Javonni it ochganini aytganimda singlim gapimni qo‘lladi.

example: Her praise motivated me to cook again, despite the first burnt pie.
translation: Uning maqtovi birinchi pirog kuyganiga qaramay, yana pishirishga ruhlantirdi.

example: I comforted my niece after her snowman lost its head.
translation: Qor odamining boshi tushib ketgach, jiyanimni ovutdim.

example: The dentist reassured me that the loud drill was next door.
translation: Tish shifokori baland parma ovozi qo‘shni xonadan kelayotganini aytib meni xotirjam qildi.

example: I had sympathy for him after the puppy ate his homework for real.
translation: Kuchukcha uy vazifasini rostdan yegach, men unga hamdard bo‘ldim.

example: She showed understanding when I arrived wearing two different shoes.
translation: Ikki xil tuflida kelganimda u holatimni tushunib munosabat bildirdi.

example: Her kindness included pretending my first cake was delicious.
translation: Uning mehribonligi birinchi tortimni mazali deb ko‘rsatishida ham namoyon bo‘ldi.

example: He hugged his brother carefully because they were both holding ice cream.
translation: Ikkalasi ham muzqaymoq ushlab turgani uchun u ukasini ehtiyotkorlik bilan quchoqladi.

example: Mum praised my clean room before opening the cupboard.
translation: Oyim javonni ochishidan oldin toza xonamni maqtadi.

example: Her compliment about my hat made me wear it all week.
translation: Shlyapam haqidagi iltifoti sabab uni hafta bo‘yi kiyib yurdim.

example: I appreciate your help, especially the part where you brought biscuits.
translation: Yordamingizni, ayniqsa pechenye olib kelganingizni qadrlayman.

example: He accepted my apology and the slightly damaged replacement cake.
translation: U uzrimni va o‘rniga olib kelgan sal shikastlangan tortni qabul qildi.

meaning: bir yoqadan bosh chiqarib harakat qilmoq
example: We pulled together to clean the flat before Mum arrived.
translation: Oyim kelmasidan uyni tozalash uchun bir yoqadan bosh chiqardik.

example: He defended his little sister when the older children laughed at her drawing.
translation: Katta bolalar singlisining rasmiga kulganda u singlisini himoya qildi.

example: I looked after my nephew, who gave me a list of his rules.
translation: Jiyanimga qaradim, u esa menga o‘z qoidalari ro‘yxatini berdi.

example: My friends stood by me after my terrible performance in the school play.
translation: Maktab spektaklida yomon o‘ynaganimdan keyin do‘stlarim yonimda turishdi.

example: I let my sister down by forgetting her concert, so I apologised.
translation: Konsertini unutib singlimning ishonchini oqlamadim, shuning uchun uzr so‘radim.

example: We cheered on our grandad as he finished his first fun run.
translation: Bobomiz ilk havaskorlar yugurishini tugatayotganida uni olqishlab ruhlantirdik.

example: My only symptom was a cough, but Dad brought three blankets.
translation: Yagona alomatim yo‘tal edi, ammo dadam uchta ko‘rpa olib keldi.

example: His fever kept him in bed, where he became the family TV expert.
translation: Isitmasi uni yotoqda ushlab turdi va u oilaning televizor mutaxassisiga aylandi.

example: My cough interrupted the film at all the quiet moments.
translation: Yo‘talim filmning barcha sokin joylarini buzdi.

example: I sneezed just as the photographer said 'perfect'.
translation: Suratkash «ajoyib» degan zahoti aksirdim.

example: I had a headache, so my brother practised his trumpet somewhere else.
translation: Boshim og‘rigani uchun ukam karnayni boshqa joyda mashq qildi.

example: A stomachache made me regret the third piece of cake.
translation: Qorin og‘rig‘i uchinchi bo‘lak tortni yeganimdan afsuslantirdi.

example: My toothache finally persuaded me to call the dentist.
translation: Tish og‘rig‘im nihoyat meni tish shifokoriga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga undadi.

example: After moving the sofa, we shared both tea and backache.
translation: Divanni ko‘chirgandan keyin choy ham, bel og‘rig‘i ham hammamizga nasib etdi.

example: My throat is sore, so my terrible singing is cancelled today.
translation: Tomog‘im achishib og‘riyapti, shuning uchun bugun yomon qo‘shiqlarim bekor.

example: I felt dizzy after spinning round to show off my new coat.
translation: Yangi paltomni ko‘z-ko‘z qilib aylangach, boshim aylandi.

example: The smell of the old milk made me feel sick.
translation: Eski sutning hidi ko‘nglimni aynitdi.

example: He looked pale, so we asked him to sit down.
translation: Rangi oqarib ketgani uchun undan o‘tirishni so‘radik.

example: My swollen ankle would not fit into my favourite shoe.
translation: Shishgan to‘pig‘im sevimli tuflimga sig‘madi.

example: The rash on my arm made me stop trying that new soap.
translation: Qo‘limdagi toshma yangi sovunni ishlatishni to‘xtatishimga sabab bo‘ldi.

example: My nose always seems to itch when both hands are covered in flour.
translation: Ikkala qo‘lim unga belanganida burnim doim qichishadigandek tuyuladi.

example: The pain in my foot explained why I was walking like a penguin.
translation: Oyog‘imdagi og‘riq nega pingvindek yurayotganimni tushuntirdi.

example: My shoulders ache after carrying all those picnic bags.
translation: Barcha sayr sumkalarini ko‘targanimdan keyin yelkalarim simillab og‘riyapti.

example: I was breathless after climbing the stairs with a giant teddy bear.
translation: Ulkan ayiqchani ko‘tarib zinadan chiqqach, nafasim qisildi.

example: We shivered outside while Dad searched every pocket for the key.
translation: Dadam kalitni barcha cho‘ntaklaridan qidirayotganda tashqarida titrab turdik.

example: I sweat when I dance, even if the dance lasts one minute.
translation: Raqs atigi bir daqiqa davom etsa ham terlayman.

example: The flu ruined his weekend plans but improved his knowledge of daytime TV.
translation: Gripp uning dam olish rejalarini buzdi, ammo kunduzgi ko‘rsatuvlar haqidagi bilimini oshirdi.

example: The doctor checked my ear for an infection while I tried to sit still.
translation: Men qimirlamay o‘tirishga urinayotganimda shifokor qulog‘imni infeksiyaga tekshirdi.

example: My allergy to cats makes visiting my aunt a very sneezy experience.
translation: Mushuklarga allergiyam tufayli xolamnikida ko‘p aksiraman.

example: We were exhausted after entertaining five children and one energetic grandmother.
translation: Beshta bola va bitta serg‘ayrat buvining ko‘nglini olgach, holdan toydik.

example: She felt unwell and left the party before the embarrassing games began.
translation: Tobi yo‘qligi uchun u noqulay o‘yinlar boshlanishidan oldin bazmdan ketdi.

example: His knee injury came from dancing, although he preferred to say sport.
translation: U sportdan deb aytishni ma’qul ko‘rsa-da, tizzasidagi jarohat raqsdan edi.

example: This bruise is a souvenir from the coffee table.
translation: Bu ko‘kargan joy jurnal stolchasidan esdalik.

example: The scratch on my arm came from a rose, not an angry tiger.
translation: Qo‘limdagi tirnalgan joy g‘azabli yo‘lbarsdan emas, atirguldan edi.

example: My new shoes gave me a blister and a reason to sit down.
translation: Yangi tuflilarim oyog‘imni qavartirib, o‘tirish uchun sabab berdi.

example: The nurse cleaned the wound while I stared bravely at the ceiling.
translation: Hamshira yarani tozalayotganda shiftga jasurlarcha tikildim.

example: He sprained his ankle while celebrating a goal he hadn't scored.
translation: U o‘zi urmagan golni nishonlayotib to‘pig‘ining payini cho‘zib oldi.

example: The X-ray showed a fracture, ending my plans to dance that evening.
translation: Rentgen suyak singanini ko‘rsatib, o‘sha kechki raqs rejalarimni bekor qildi.

example: My finger started to bleed after an argument with a sharp envelope.
translation: O‘tkir konvert bilan «tortishuvdan» keyin barmog‘im qonay boshladi.

example: My feet hurt after I wore stylish shoes to a long wedding.
translation: Uzoq davom etgan to‘yga zamonaviy tufli kiyganimdan keyin oyoqlarim og‘ridi.

example: I slipped on a wet floor but managed to save my sandwich.
translation: Ho‘l polda sirpandim, ammo sendvichimni saqlab qoldim.

example: I stumbled over my own bag while warning everyone to be careful.
translation: Hammaga ehtiyot bo‘lishni aytayotib o‘z sumkamga qoqildim.

example: He nearly fainted at the sight of blood, even in a cartoon.
translation: U hatto multfilmda qon ko‘rib ham hushidan ketay dedi.

example: After the fall, she was conscious and asking where her glasses were.
translation: Yiqilganidan keyin uning hushi joyida edi va ko‘zoynagini so‘rayotgandi.

example: The man was unconscious, so someone immediately called an ambulance.
translation: Erkak hushsiz edi, shuning uchun kimdir darrov tez yordam chaqirdi.

example: They carried the injured player on a stretcher while he waved to his mum.
translation: Jarohatlangan o‘yinchini zambilda olib ketishayotganda u onasiga qo‘l silkitdi.

example: In an emergency, clear information matters more than a long story.
translation: Shoshilinch vaziyatda uzun hikoyadan ko‘ra aniq ma’lumot muhimroq.

example: The bandage on my hand made washing dishes difficult, which my brother doubted.
translation: Qo‘limdagi bog‘lam idish yuvishni qiyinlashtirdi, akam esa bunga shubhalandi.

example: My niece chose a plaster with dinosaurs for her tiny cut.
translation: Jiyanim kichik kesigiga dinozavrli yopishqoq tasma tanladi.

example: This scar comes from a bicycle accident, not a battle with a shark.
translation: Bu chandiq akula bilan jangdan emas, velosiped halokatidan qolgan.

example: A mosquito chose my ankle from all the people at the picnic.
translation: Chivin sayrdagi barcha odamlar ichidan mening to‘pig‘imni tanladi.

example: The bracelet was too big for my wrist but perfect for the teddy bear.
translation: Bilaguzuk bilagimga katta, ayiqchaga esa juda mos edi.

example: My elbow knocked over the salt during an enthusiastic story.
translation: Hayajon bilan hikoya qilayotib tirsagim bilan tuzni ag‘dardim.

example: The doctor listened to my chest with a very cold stethoscope.
translation: Shifokor ko‘kragimni juda sovuq stetoskop bilan tingladi.

example: A dry throat made my welcome speech sound like a frog's greeting.
translation: Quruq tomog‘im sabab tabrik nutqim qurbaqaning salomiga o‘xshadi.

example: My skin turned red where I had forgotten the sunscreen.
translation: Quyoshdan himoya kremini surtishni unutgan joyimdagi teri qizardi.

example: I arrived early for my appointment and read a magazine older than my nephew.
translation: Qabulga erta kelib, jiyanimdan ham eski jurnalni o‘qidim.

example: The clinic had comfortable chairs, but nobody wanted to stay longer.
translation: Klinikada qulay stullar bor edi, ammo hech kim uzoqroq qolishni istamadi.

example: At the pharmacy, I forgot the medicine's name but remembered its orange box.
translation: Dorixonada dori nomini unutdim, ammo to‘q sariq qutisini esladim.

example: The pharmacist patiently listened to my description of a mysterious blue box.
translation: Farmatsevt sirli ko‘k quti haqidagi ta’rifimni sabr bilan tingladi.

example: The medicine tasted awful, so I made a face even before taking it.
translation: Dorining ta’mi yomon edi, shuning uchun ichishdan oldinoq yuzimni burishtirdim.

example: The ointment came in a tiny tube with surprisingly long instructions.
translation: Dorivor surtma ajablanarli uzun yo‘riqnomali kichik tubikda edi.

example: She checked the label before taking the pill, unlike her impatient husband.
translation: U sabrsiz eridan farqli ravishda hapdorini ichishdan oldin yorliqni tekshirdi.

example: I put the prescription in my pocket and checked it five times.
translation: Retseptni cho‘ntagimga solib, besh marta tekshirdim.

example: The label explained the dose more clearly than my uncle did.
translation: Yorliqda dori miqdori amakimning tushuntirishidan aniqroq yozilgan edi.

example: Her treatment finished before she finished the clinic's crossword.
translation: U klinikadagi krossvordni tugatmasidan muolajasi tugadi.

example: He hoped for a quick cure so he could return to his dance class.
translation: Raqs darsiga qaytish uchun u tez ta’sir qiladigan davodan umid qildi.

example: I hope you get better before your uncle offers to sing for you again.
translation: Amakingiz yana kuylab berishni taklif qilishidan oldin sog‘ayishingizni tilayman.

example: The cut healed, but I still treated that envelope with respect.
translation: Kesik bitdi, ammo men o‘sha konvertga hamon hurmat bilan qarardim.

example: The doctor examined my knee while I explained my ambitious dance move.
translation: Men katta raqs harakatimni tushuntirayotganda shifokor tizzamni tekshirdi.

example: The nurse checked my pulse while I tried not to talk about lunch.
translation: Tushlik haqida gapirmaslikka urinayotganimda hamshira tomir urishimni tekshirdi.

example: The injection was over before I finished my brave speech.
translation: Jasurlik haqidagi nutqimni tugatmasimdan ukol tugadi.

example: After the vaccination, my nephew proudly showed everyone his little plaster.
translation: Emlashdan keyin jiyanim kichik plastirini hammaga faxr bilan ko‘rsatdi.

example: After the operation, he was more interested in lunch than in television.
translation: Operatsiyadan keyin uni televizordan ko‘ra tushlik ko‘proq qiziqtirdi.

example: The surgeon explained everything clearly, even to my worried uncle.
translation: Jarroh hamma narsani, hatto xavotirdagi amakimga ham aniq tushuntirdi.

example: Everyone in the ward knew when my uncle received visitors.
translation: Kasalxona bo‘limidagi hamma amakimga mehmon kelganini bilardi.

example: My check-up took less time than finding a parking space.
translation: Tibbiy ko‘rigim mashina qo‘yish joyini topishdan kamroq vaqt oldi.

example: The X-ray showed my bones, but thankfully not my embarrassing dance moves.
translation: Rentgen suyaklarimni ko‘rsatdi, xayriyatki, uyatli raqs harakatlarimni emas.

example: She packed her medical records more carefully than her holiday clothes.
translation: U tibbiy hujjatlarini ta’til kiyimlaridan ham ehtiyotkorroq joyladi.

example: My health matters more than winning our neighbourhood cake-eating contest.
translation: Sog‘lig‘im mahallamizdagi tort yeyish musobaqasida g‘olib bo‘lishdan muhimroq.

example: Sleepiness was a possible side effect listed on the medicine box.
translation: Uyquchanlik dori qutisida keltirilgan ehtimoliy nojo‘ya ta’sirlardan biri edi.

example: A healthy breakfast does not become healthier when you photograph it.
translation: Foydali nonushta uni suratga olganingiz bilan yanada foydaliroq bo‘lib qolmaydi.

example: My fitness improved when the lift stopped working.
translation: Lift ishlamay qolgach, jismoniy chiniqqanligim yaxshilandi.

example: More physical activity sounded easy until I met the stairs.
translation: Zinapoyaga duch kelgunimcha ko‘proq jismoniy faollik oson tuyuldi.

example: We loosened up before dancing so our knees wouldn't complain.
translation: Tizzalarimiz shikoyat qilmasin deb raqsdan oldin mushaklarimizni yozdik.

example: I unwind after work by watering plants and ignoring my phone.
translation: Ishdan keyin gullarni sug‘orib va telefonimga qaramay hordiq chiqaraman.

meaning: diqqatni jamlab sokin o‘tirmoq; meditatsiya qilmoq
example: I tried to meditate, but the cat thought my lap was a new bed.
translation: Meditatsiya qilishga urindim, ammo mushuk tizzamni yangi yotoq deb o‘yladi.

example: After the race, I needed a moment to breathe before telling my heroic story.
translation: Poygadan keyin qahramonlik hikoyamni aytishdan oldin nafas rostlashim kerak edi.

example: My ten-minute nap somehow lasted until dinner.
translation: O‘n daqiqalik kunduzgi uyqum qandaydir qilib kechki ovqatgacha cho‘zildi.

example: Grandad snores so loudly that nobody hears the film.
translation: Bobom shunchalik baland xurrak otadiki, hech kim filmni eshitmaydi.

example: I yawned during my own story and decided to finish it quickly.
translation: O‘z hikoyamni aytayotib esnadim va uni tezroq tugatishga qaror qildim.

example: I was wide awake, but my brain had not arrived at work yet.
translation: Men butunlay uyg‘oq edim, ammo miyam hali ishga yetib kelmagan edi.

example: He was asleep before he finished complaining about the uncomfortable pillow.
translation: Noqulay yostiqdan shikoyat qilib bo‘lmasidan u uxlab qoldi.

example: At bedtime, my nephew suddenly has seventeen important questions.
translation: Uxlash paytida jiyanimning birdan o‘n yettita muhim savoli paydo bo‘ladi.

example: During a week of insomnia, I became very familiar with the ceiling.
translation: Bir haftalik uyqusizlik paytida shiftni juda yaxshi o‘rganib oldim.

example: The children had enough energy to chase the adults after the picnic.
translation: Sayrdan keyin bolalarda kattalarni quvishga ham yetarli quvvat bor edi.

example: The long walk gave me an appetite large enough to surprise Grandma.
translation: Uzoq sayrdan keyin ishtaham buvimni ham hayratlantiradigan darajada ochildi.

example: His diet includes vegetables, although he negotiates with every carrot.
translation: Uning ovqatlanish tartibida sabzavotlar bor, garchi har bir sabzi bilan kelishishga urinsa ham.

example: We discussed nutrition while carefully avoiding the subject of yesterday's cake.
translation: Kecha yegan tort mavzusini ehtiyotkorlik bilan chetlab, oziqlanish haqida gaplashdik.

example: She read about each vitamin instead of believing her uncle's loud advice.
translation: U amakisining baland ovozdagi maslahatiga ishonish o‘rniga har bir vitamin haqida o‘qidi.

example: The lesson on hygiene made the children inspect Dad's fingernails.
translation: Gigiyena darsi bolalarni dadamning tirnoqlarini tekshirishga undadi.

example: I have a habit of checking the fridge when I need a break.
translation: Dam kerak bo‘lganda muzlatkichni tekshirish odatim bor.

example: My morning routine begins with finding the alarm under my pillow.
translation: Ertalabki tartibim yostiq ostidagi budilnikni topishdan boshlanadi.

example: I'm trying to cut down on sugar, and my tea seems surprised.
translation: Shakar iste’molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman, choyim esa hayronday.

example: He gave up smoking and started collecting unusual mugs instead.
translation: U chekishni tashlab, o‘rniga g‘alati krujkalar yig‘a boshladi.

example: We work out together, then argue about who deserves the biggest sandwich.
translation: Birga mashq qilamiz, keyin eng katta sendvich kimga tegishini tortishamiz.

example: An honest dialogue helped us settle the argument about our noisy flat.
translation: Samimiy suhbat shovqinli uyimiz haqidagi bahsni hal qilishga yordam berdi.

example: Our debate about house rules ended with everyone washing one dish.
translation: Uy qoidalari haqidagi bahsimiz hamma bittadan idish yuvishi bilan tugadi.

example: I confided in my sister about my fear of giving a speech.
translation: Nutq so‘zlash qo‘rquvimni singlimga ishonib aytdim.

example: Please don't refer to my burnt cake during the wedding speech.
translation: Iltimos, to‘ydagi nutqda kuygan tortimni tilga olmang.

example: Mum spelled out the rules before leaving us alone with the cake.
translation: Oyim bizni tort bilan yolg‘iz qoldirishdan oldin qoidalarni aniq tushuntirdi.

example: To sum up our picnic: lovely people, wet sandwiches.
translation: Sayrimizni qisqacha aytsam: ajoyib odamlar, ho‘l sendvichlar.

example: He acknowledged my warning with a nod, then touched the wet paint.
translation: U bosh irg‘ab ogohlantirishimni eshitganini bildirdi, keyin ho‘l bo‘yoqqa tegdi.

example: How did your mother react when she saw your purple hair?
translation: Binafsha sochingizni ko‘rganda onangiz qanday munosabat bildirdi?

example: He declared that he could cook, then asked where we kept the eggs.
translation: U ovqat pishira olishini qat’iy aytib, keyin tuxum qayerdaligini so‘radi.

example: Please inform your guests that the parrot repeats everything.
translation: Mehmonlaringizni to‘tiqush hamma gapni takrorlashidan xabardor qiling.

example: Remind me to buy milk before I pour water on my cereal again.
translation: Yana yormamga suv quyishimdan oldin sut olishni eslat.

example: Could you clarify whether 'early' means before lunch or before sunrise?
translation: «Erta» deganingiz tushlikdan oldinmi yoki quyosh chiqishidan oldinmi, aniqlashtirasizmi?

example: I can pronounce her surname now, but only after a deep breath.
translation: Endi uning familiyasini talaffuz qila olaman, ammo avval chuqur nafas olishim kerak.

example: He whispered the secret so loudly that the next table listened.
translation: U sirni shunchalik baland pichirladiki, qo‘shni stol ham eshitdi.

example: Dad muttered about the instructions while holding them upside down.
translation: Dadam yo‘riqnomani teskari ushlab, undan g‘udrandi.

example: Her remark about my giant hat started a very cheerful conversation.
translation: Uning ulkan shlyapam haqidagi izohi juda quvnoq suhbatni boshlab berdi.

example: Nobody commented on the cake's unusual shape until it fell over.
translation: Tort yiqilib tushmaguncha hech kim uning noodatiy shakli haqida fikr bildirmadi.

example: She pointed out that I was searching for glasses already on my head.
translation: U boshimda turgan ko‘zoynakni qidirayotganimni aytib qo‘ydi.

example: Don't bring up my driving test while Uncle is drinking tea.
translation: Amakim choy ichayotganda haydovchilik imtihonim mavzusini ko‘tarma.

example: Please speak up; the blender is winning this conversation.
translation: Iltimos, balandroq gapiring; bu suhbatda blender yutyapti.

example: I finally got my point across by drawing the broken chair.
translation: Singan stulning rasmini chizib, nihoyat fikrimni tushuntira oldim.

example: Grandma has a saying for every problem, including broken kettles.
translation: Buvimda har bir muammoga, hatto singan choynakka ham maqol bor.

example: I understood the meaning of his smile when I saw the hidden cake.
translation: Yashirilgan tortni ko‘rib, uning tabassumi ma’nosini tushundim.

example: My polite enquiry about dinner received a very long answer.
translation: Kechki ovqat haqidagi odobli so‘rovimga juda uzun javob berildi.

example: My willpower lasted until someone opened the chocolate box.
translation: Irodam kimdir shokolad qutisini ochguncha chidadi.

example: Honesty is a virtue, though my uncle's comments about haircuts test it.
translation: Rostgo‘ylik fazilat, garchi amakimning soch turmagi haqidagi gaplari buni sinasa ham.

example: His biggest flaw is promising to help and then forgetting.
translation: Uning eng katta kamchiligi yordam va’da qilib, keyin unutishidir.

example: She has a gift for making strangers feel welcome.
translation: U notanish kishilarni samimiy kutib olishning tabiiy qobiliyatiga ega.

example: Not laughing at his enormous hat required real self-control.
translation: Uning ulkan shlyapasiga kulmaslik uchun chinakam o‘zini tuta bilish kerak edi.

example: The teacher saw potential in my acting, even when I forgot every line.
translation: Hamma gapimni unutganimda ham o‘qituvchi aktyorlik salohiyatimni ko‘rdi.

example: He matured after moving out and stopped calling Mum about every missing sock.
translation: Alohida yashagach u ulg‘ayib, har yo‘qolgan paypoq uchun oyisiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmay qo‘ydi.

example: I learned from my mistake and kept the birthday cake away from the dog.
translation: Xatoimdan saboq olib, tug‘ilgan kun tortini itdan uzoqda saqladim.

example: She achieved her goal of speaking confidently, even with a noisy microphone.
translation: Shovqinli mikrofonga qaramay, u ishonch bilan gapirish maqsadiga erishdi.

example: After listening to that long story, you deserve a second slice of cake.
translation: O‘sha uzun hikoyani tinglaganingdan keyin ikkinchi bo‘lak tortga loyiqsan.

example: Keeping a plant alive requires commitment, as my empty pots prove.
translation: Bo‘sh tuvaklarim ko‘rsatganidek, o‘simlikni yashatish qat’iy mas’uliyat talab qiladi.

example: I promised to arrive on time and set three alarms.
translation: Vaqtida kelishga va’da berib, uchta budilnik qo‘ydim.
